Job Posting: 178927 - Position: S26 Data Analyst Co-op - DigiBC Work Placement 178927B Co-op Work Term Posted: 2026 - Summer App Deadline Application Method: Posting Goes Live: Job Posting Status: 03/15/2026 11:59 PM Through Employer Website 03/09/2026 12:54 PM Approved ORGANIZATION INFORMATION Organization City Province / State Country Blastworks Vancouver BC Canada JOB POSTING INFORMATION Placement Term <b> Job Title <b> Position Type Job Location Country Duration Work Mode Salary Currency Salary Job Description Blastworks 2026 - Summer S26 Data Analyst Co-op - DigiBC Work Placement 178927B Co-op Position Victoria, BC Canada 4 or 8 months In-Person CAD 21.63 per hour for 37.5 Major List Role: Data Analyst Co-Op Reports To: Managing Director Location: In-office, Victoria, BC Employment Type: Full-time, 4-8 month co-op placement Hours: 37.5 - 40 hours / week Start Date: May 4, 2026 (or earlier if possible) End Date: August 28, 2026 Salary: 21.63 per hour Experience Level: Student Co-op / Entry Level Portfolio: REQUIRED Summary of position Blastworks is a Victoria-based mobile and social gaming studio focused on premium casual and social casino experiences. Our games are played by millions of users globally, and product decisions are guided heavily by player data. We are looking for a curious and analytical Product Analytics Co-op student who wants to learn how data is used to improve real products. You will work closely with Product, Marketing, and Leadership to explore player behavior, analyze feature performance, and help translate game data into actionable insights. This role focuses on product analytics and business insight, not data engineering. What You'll Do: Player Behavior & Game Analytics • Analyze player engagement, retention, and monetization trends • Explore how players interact with game features and events Help identify patterns that influence player behavior • KPI Reporting & Dashboard Support • Assist in building and improving Tableau dashboards used by product and leadership • Support reporting on key game KPIs such as retention, engagement, and revenue Help investigate unusual changes or anomalies in product performance • Product Experimentation & Feature Analysis • Support analysis of new feature launches and product experiments • Help evaluate A/B test results and measure feature impact Work with Product to understand how success is defined for new features • Ad-hoc Product Questions • Write SQL queries to answer business and product questions Help translate analytical findings into clear summaries for stakeholders • What You'll Gain • Experience working with live game and player data • Exposure to product analytics in a real gaming studio • Practical experience writing SQL and building dashboards • Mentorship from experienced product and analytics leaders • Understanding how data supports real product decisions At Blastworks, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where all individuals feel a genuine sense of belonging and trust. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our community. If you thrive in a fast-moving industry and love building experiences that players love, we'd love to hear from you. This position is part of DigiBC's Work Placement Program (https://wpp.digibc.org), which supports post-secondary students by providing experiential learning opportunities in animation, video, games, visual effects, and XR. As a part of this program, participating students will benefit from customized orientation workshops, e-learning resources, mentoring support, and the opportunity to start building their own professional network in the creative technology industry. This program is open to students who are Canadian Citizens, Permanent Residents, or Protected Person as defined by the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act. Job Requirements What you Bring: • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field • Basic SQL experience (coursework or projects) • Strong Excel skills (formulas, pivot tables, data analysis) • Exposure to data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, etc.) • Curiosity about how products work and how data can improve them • Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly Interest in gaming, mobile apps, or digital products • Nice to Have: • Experience with Python or R for data analysis • Experience working with large datasets in SQL • Familiarity with A/B testing concepts Experience with Tableau dashboard creation • Citizenship Requirement Canadian & Permanent Residents & Refugees Only APPLICATION INFORMATION Application Procedure Through Employer Website Special Application Instructions Please include a portfolio of your work to support your CV's Application Link: https://pod4.app.loxo.co/job/Mzg0NjQtZjdkd2Y3azI2N3dsZ3l3MQ==?t=1773076782092 If the link no longer takes you to this position, then the role has been closed for applications.
